title: Pre-Analysis (Closed) — Stabiliser Box Stiffener Extension, Shop Retrofit Offer
abstract: Closed pre-analysis supporting the shop retrofit offer for the stiffener extension, confirming that the work could be embodied at a stabiliser overhaul without disturbing the interim crack repair population.

sections.objective: Establish whether the extended stiffener run and thicker splice plate could be offered as a shop retrofit at stabiliser overhaul, and how aircraft already carrying the interim splice repair would be handled.
sections.findings_summary: Four items were confirmed and none blocking, although one condition was attached. The interim crack repair is embodied on eleven aircraft and sits in the same region as the thicker splice plate; the review found that the repair has to be removed rather than overlaid, and that the removal is inside the shop scope but was not written down anywhere. The inspection task needed its eddy current coverage extended outboard for the modified standard, which had been drafted but not issued. The bulletin's interchangeability statement held after embodiment, which was the operator's main question. Two aircraft in the population had a repair approval on the same panel and were excluded from the offer pending a case-by-case review.
sections.next_steps: Retrofit offer approved with the interim repair removal written into the accomplishment. The two aircraft with repair approvals were handled individually.

similarity_seeds: a modification embodied over an interim repair that was never meant to be permanent

tasks.title: Check the inspection coverage for the modified standard

expected_findings.rationale: The interim crack repair occupies the same fastener rows as the thicker splice plate. It must be removed and the holes assessed before the modification is embodied, and nothing said so.
expected_findings.resolution: Write the interim repair removal into the bulletin accomplishment.

expected_findings.rationale: Two aircraft in the population carry a repair approval on the same panel and cannot be covered by a standard accomplishment.
expected_findings.resolution: Exclude those two aircraft from the offer and handle them individually.

expected_findings.rationale: The extended eddy current coverage for the modified standard had been drafted but not issued, so a shop releasing a modified stabiliser would inspect to the wrong coverage.
expected_findings.resolution: Issue the task revision before the first shop embodiment.

expected_findings.rationale: The deleted stringer still appeared without an effectivity note, which would let a shop order a part that the modified standard does not use.
expected_findings.resolution: Correct the figure effectivity with the task revision.

type_data.conclusion: Closed. Shop retrofit offer approved with the interim repair removal written into the accomplishment.
